layout.birthday.tribute.titleCard.element: title card ('Happy birthday, {name}!') (read by the worker)
layout.birthday.tribute.titleCard.evidence: https://static.vidday.com/videos/vidday-group-videos-getting-started-2-minute-tour.mp4 (1920x1080, 30 fps); frame references/auto/vidday/frames/vidday-tour-t118.300-phone.png (phone crop x680-1240, y40-1040) frame 118.3 s: player y135-688 (553 px) x8-549 in the phone crop; caps lines y368-400 and y422-454.5 (cap height 33.0 px); widest line x81-478 (398 px), centred at x279; stem width 5.16 px (sub-pixel coverage, 19 stems)
layout.birthday.tribute.titleCard.method: background = median of 125,000 paper pixels (239,238,243); text = median of the darkest 25 % of glyph pixels (68,67,71); fontSizeRatio = cap 33.0 / 553 / Roboto cap-height 0.711; centerYRatio = caps-block centre 411.25 -> (411.25-135)/553 = 0.4995; maxWidthRatio = 398 px / (553 x 16/9) = 0.405 (VidDay's 1080p frame is 16:9, cropped to fill a square player on the gift page); fontWeight = stem/cap 0.156, nearest Roboto weight Medium (0.173; Regular 0.134, both rendered from backend/worker/fonts)
layout.birthday.tribute.titleCard.precision: colours ±8/255 (H.264); ratios ±2 %; maxWidthRatio depends on the 16:9 crop reading; weight between Regular and Medium
layout.birthday.tribute.titleCard.notes: VidDay draws this text in its theme's hand-lettered face over watercolour confetti; the confetti art and face are not copied (solid paper colour, platform Roboto in the worker). P-BT-1 normalises the reference's capitals to Sentence case. MERGE memory M-4.
